reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates B2 precipitate formation and a ductility-strength balance improvement in a specific Al-Nb-Ta-Ti-V-Zr alloy, but does not provide any data on TiVNbTa or on high-temperature (1273 K) mechanical behavior. The key premise that this approach will improve high-temperature yield strength in TiVNbTa is therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
